Opened by ops-lukas on 2026-09-03

If an export fails (for example the server returns an error), the Export button
stays greyed out and I can't click it again until I reload the whole page.

args.title: Re-enable the export button after a failed export
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

In handleClick, the promise chain only calls setBusy(false) in the success callback of exportReport(...).then(...). When the fetch in exportReport rejects (non-2xx response or network error), the rejection is never caught, so setBusy(false) is never called and the button remains disabled until the page is reloaded.

Propose adding a .catch (or a try/catch with async/await) around the exportReport call that resets busy to false and shows an error toast (e.g. toast.show(t("ui.export.failed"), "error")) on failure, mirroring the existing success path. This ensures the button becomes clickable again after a failed export, without needing a full page reload.
